channel.title: Creating MTF's...
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Creating MTF's..." - TL/DR: I want to create an MTF and write action/mission reports on encounters with SCP's + stories on the important figures as well - is that possible?

item.title: Re: Creating MTF's...
item.content:encoded:
do you think it might be a viable idea to have a "reference section" at the end of the tale where these details could be listed?

I'm not entirely convinced that the audience would find such a section interesting, but then I've never been a huge fan of laundry-list material.

If you really want to have a list of reference minutiae, keep it on the side when writing and then ask reviewers if they think it improves the draft to include it. If people don't think it's necessary, leave it out. If people like that sort of thing, include it.

item.title: Re: Creating MTF's...
item.content:encoded: Out of curiosity, do you think it might be a viable idea to have a "reference section" at the end of the tale where these details could be listed?

item.title: Re: Creating MTF's...
item.content:encoded:
Could I possibly create a MTF and create a dossier detailing what they do/would do

MTFs typically don't have their own dossier pages. Do you have an example of the kind of page you would make for a dossier?

Then write tales + mission reports on encounters my MTF has with SCP's as well as backstories on important figures within the MTF?

You should write tales/after action reports first, since a dossier would be just a laundry list information dump without the background stories existing. Keep in mind that your material needs to entertain the audience with a story, rather than a list of facts about a group they haven't committed their interest to yet.

item.title: Creating MTF's...
item.content:encoded: Just wondering: Could I possibly create a MTF and create a dossier detailing what they do/would do, the people that run said MTF, etc. Then write tales + mission reports on encounters my MTF has with SCP's as well as backstories on important figures within the MTF?
